SECTION E: Case Study Based (4 Marks)

Q36. Case Study 1: The Auditorium
Seats in rows form an AP: 30, 34, 38, ...
(i) Find seats in 10th row. (1)
(ii) If there are 15 rows, find total seating capacity. (1)
(iii) (a) Find total production in first 7 years. (2) OR
(b) Seats in middle row if there are 25 rows. (2)

Answer / Solution:
AP: a = 30, d = 4
(i) a10 = a + 9d = 30 + 9×4 = 66
(ii) S15 = 15/2 [2a + 14d] = 15/2 [60 + 56] = 870
(iii)(b) Middle row of 25 rows is 13th row:
a13 = 30 + 12×4 = 78
(iii)(a) As per given solution mapping in the paper:
a3 = 600 and a7 = 700
So 4d = 100 => d = 25; a = 550
S7 = 7/2 (a + a7) = 7/2 (550 + 700) = 4375
Answers:
(i) 66
(ii) 870
(iii)(a) 4375 OR (b) 78
